Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified the White House as the landmark featured in the August 2021 Vogue cover. The cover actually features Jill Biden at the White House, but the landmark in the background is not the White House itself; it is the Washington Monument. This misidentification led to the subsequent steps focusing on calculating the height of the White House rather than the correct landmark, resulting in an incorrect solution to the problem.
